Location: Felixstowe, UK
Description:

Experienced Chief Engineer required for a modern tug fleet operating in the UK. The role involves maintaining high-powered machinery, diagnosing faults, and ensuring engine room safety. This permanent position offers a time-for-time contract with a 1 week on / 1 week off rotation. A salary of £68,440.88 is provided, along with pension, private medical insurance, and life cover. STCW III/3 (III/2 preferred) and ENG1 certification are essential. Previous experience in harbour towage or small vessels is advantageous. Candidates must have the right to work in the UK.
